requirements.title: Platform Performance & Reliability
requirements.statement: The platform shall maintain 99.95% uptime and respond to all control commands within 50ms under nominal operating conditions.
requirements.rationale: High availability and low latency are critical for real-time control systems to ensure operational safety and user confidence in the platform.

requirements.title: System Safety & Fail-Safe Operation
requirements.statement: The system shall enter a fail-safe state within 100ms of detecting any single-point-of-failure condition as defined in the FMEA.
requirements.rationale: Mandatory for certification compliance under IEC 61508 SIL-2. Fail-safe behavior prevents cascading failures and protects personnel.

requirements.title: Power Sub-System Regulation
requirements.statement: The power sub-system shall regulate output voltage within ±2% of nominal under all specified load and temperature conditions.
requirements.rationale: Stable power delivery is essential for sensitive analog and digital circuits downstream. Voltage excursions beyond ±2% risk component damage.

requirements.title: Communication Sub-System Bandwidth
requirements.statement: The communication sub-system shall guarantee minimum 1 Gbps full-duplex throughput with less than 1ms jitter between all nodes.
requirements.rationale: High-bandwidth low-jitter communication is required to support real-time telemetry and control data exchange across distributed nodes.

requirements.title: Control Sub-System Determinism
requirements.statement: The control sub-system shall execute all safety-critical control loops with deterministic cycle times not exceeding 1ms.
requirements.rationale: Deterministic execution prevents timing-related control instabilities that could lead to oscillation or loss of control in safety-critical paths.

requirements.title: Voltage Regulator Accuracy
requirements.statement: The voltage regulator component shall maintain output within ±2% under all load conditions from 0% to 100% rated current.
requirements.rationale: Derived from REQ_02_01. The regulator is the primary means of achieving voltage stability in the power sub-system.

requirements.title: Surge Protection Clamping Speed
requirements.statement: The surge protection component shall clamp voltage transients to safe levels within 10 microseconds of onset.
requirements.rationale: Fast clamping prevents transient voltage spikes from propagating to downstream circuitry and causing permanent damage.

requirements.title: Network Interface Throughput
requirements.statement: The network interface component shall support full-duplex operation at minimum 1 Gbps throughput with standard Ethernet frames.
requirements.rationale: Derived from REQ_02_02. The NIC is the physical layer enabler for meeting the communication sub-system bandwidth requirement.

requirements.title: Packet Scheduler Latency Guarantee
requirements.statement: The packet scheduler component shall guarantee maximum end-to-end latency of 5ms for high-priority traffic classes.
requirements.rationale: Traffic prioritization ensures that safety-critical telemetry and control packets are not delayed by lower-priority data transfers.

requirements.title: PID Controller Cycle Time
requirements.statement: The PID controller component shall execute control algorithms within 1ms cycle time on the target hardware platform.
requirements.rationale: Derived from REQ_02_03. The PID controller is the core element of the deterministic control loop architecture.

requirements.title: Fault Detection Latency
requirements.statement: The fault detection monitor shall detect and log all out-of-range sensor readings within 2ms of occurrence.
requirements.rationale: Rapid fault detection enables timely intervention and prevents undetected anomalies from escalating to safety-critical failures.

requirements.title: Battery Management SOC Tracking
requirements.statement: The battery management component shall track state-of-charge with less than 1% error across the full operating temperature range.
requirements.rationale: Accurate SOC tracking prevents unexpected power loss and enables predictive maintenance scheduling.

requirements.title: Emergency Stop Response Time
requirements.statement: The emergency stop component shall disengage all actuators within 50ms of activation signal receipt.
requirements.rationale: Rapid actuator disengagement is a fundamental safety function required for personnel protection in emergency scenarios.

requirements.title: LDO Regulator Circuit Implementation
requirements.statement: Implement LDO regulator circuit with feedback compensation per schematic REG-001 and validate output stability.
requirements.rationale: The LDO design provides the required regulation accuracy while minimizing thermal dissipation in the target form factor.

requirements.title: Voltage Regulation Test Validation
requirements.statement: Validate voltage regulation via automated test bench using standard load profiles defined in TP-REG-001.
requirements.rationale: Automated testing ensures repeatable validation across production units and captures regulation performance under all load conditions.

requirements.title: TVS Diode Array Installation
requirements.statement: Install TVS diode array per BOM reference SPG-007 on all external power ports for transient voltage suppression.
requirements.rationale: TVS diodes provide the primary clamping mechanism required to meet the surge protection clamping speed requirement.

requirements.title: Surge Clamping Compliance Test
requirements.statement: Verify surge clamping compliance via IEC 61000-4-5 test procedure at Level 3 surge (±2kV).
requirements.rationale: IEC 61000-4-5 compliance testing provides standardized evidence of surge protection capability for certification.

requirements.title: NIC Driver Configuration
requirements.statement: Configure NIC driver with Jumbo Frames support and interrupt coalescing enabled for optimal throughput.
requirements.rationale: Jumbo Frames reduce per-packet overhead while interrupt coalescing reduces CPU utilization under high throughput conditions.

requirements.title: Network Throughput Benchmark
requirements.statement: Benchmark network interface throughput using iperf3 under full system load to validate 1 Gbps requirement.
requirements.rationale: iperf3 benchmarking under realistic system load provides empirical evidence of throughput capability in the target environment.

requirements.title: DSCP Traffic Prioritization
requirements.statement: Implement DSCP-based traffic prioritization in the software packet scheduler with at least 4 traffic classes.
requirements.rationale: DSCP marking is the standard mechanism for classifying network traffic and enabling the packet scheduler to enforce latency guarantees.

requirements.title: End-to-End Latency Verification
requirements.statement: Verify end-to-end latency for high-priority traffic via timestamped packet injection test with 10,000 sample packets.
requirements.rationale: Statistical latency measurement with large sample sizes provides confidence in the 5ms latency guarantee under realistic conditions.

requirements.title: PID Algorithm RTOS Implementation
requirements.statement: Implement discrete PID algorithm in RTOS task with 1ms period and watchdog supervision for cycle overrun detection.
requirements.rationale: RTOS task scheduling with watchdog supervision ensures deterministic cycle time and detects timing violations that could affect control stability.

requirements.title: PID Cycle Time Validation
requirements.statement: Validate PID cycle time via RTOS trace log analysis on target hardware across all defined operating modes.
requirements.rationale: Trace log analysis provides non-intrusive measurement of actual cycle times, capturing worst-case timing behavior.

requirements.title: Anomaly Detection Algorithm
requirements.statement: Implement threshold-based anomaly detection using rolling average on sensor input queue with configurable window size.
requirements.rationale: Rolling average anomaly detection balances sensitivity with noise rejection, providing reliable fault detection for the safety monitoring subsystem.

requirements.title: Anomaly Event Logging
requirements.statement: Log all anomaly events to redundant black-box storage with ISO 8601 timestamps and event severity classification.
requirements.rationale: Redundant event logging with standardized timestamps enables post-incident analysis and supports regulatory audit requirements.
